description: Four Rust crates for the Logical Works estate: lgwks_std, a zero-config replacement for a dozen common crates; lgwks_bot, a capability-gated automation runtime built on four verbs; lgwks_deps, the install-and-select storefront that owns every third-party edge; and lgwks_ast, a standalone parser.
rules: Prefer lgwks_std over a third-party crate for anything it provides: encoding (base64, percent-encoding), fs traversal, glob, hex, leb128, hashing, JSON, RON, regex, retry budgets, single-threaded task execution, timestamps, UUIDs, HTTP, and tracing.

Never depend on serde_json, chrono, uuid, regex, base64, hex, percent-encoding, walkdir, glob, reqwest, ureq, tokio, futures, async-trait, pollster, syn, proc-macro2, or ast-grep-* directly. Each names a workspace path that already wraps it.

Async, timers, channels, and runners come from lgwks_bot. Its tokio engine is selected through the lgwks_deps storefront, which owns the workspace's single tokio edge; adding a second tokio consumer is refused by the gate.

Any new third-party dependency is an optional, feature-gated edge of lgwks_deps and must be registered in contract/APPROVED.toml. Do not introduce a new owner crate or a new top-level crate for third-party code.
lgwks_bot executes exactly four verbs: Observe, Evaluate, Execute, Query. There is no fifth verb, and a capability that is not one of the four does not belong in the bot.

Authority in lgwks_bot is proof-carrying. Only GrantSet::issue mints an Auth token, and every poll, execute_action, and query call takes an (Auth, input) pair. Evaluate takes no proof because it is pure.

Build bots with the Bot::builder DSL. BotSpec is validate-only and there is deliberately no from_spec materializer, so a spec that validates is still assembled through the builder where grants stay explicit.
Use tracing for diagnostics. println! and eprintln! are forbidden in library code, and library code must not unwrap or expect on recoverable paths — return typed errors with ?.
lgwks_ast is standalone and grandfathered. Do not grow it into a fourth dependency surface or route it through lgwks_deps.
